metadata.description: Curated demo subset of experiment 34 (iteration 7): the p2_directions dataset (all 80 examples) plus the committed thresholds, T10 fork definition, fork-token probabilities and calibration cells needed to re-run the F / P2 analysis on CPU.
metadata.source_dataset: p2_directions of method_out.json (all 80 examples; values are the 6-significant-digit strings of the original dataset)
metadata.method_name: fork margin (F) and default-to-runner-up axis projection (P2) vs P_t / norm / energy baselines; targeted push vs matched random; in-manifold top-five push vs random-survivor null
